question: A 55-year-old Caucasian male presents for a routine colonoscopy. A polyp is found in the patient's transverse colon and is found to be cancerous on histological evaluation. Upon examination, it is found that these cancerous cells have decreased MHC class I expression on their surface. Which immune system cell is most capable of killing these tumor cells?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Decreased MHC class I expression" -> "Decreased recognition by cytotoxic T-cells" -> "Reduced killing of tumor cells" -> "Natural killer cells" -> 95% CHAIN: "Decreased MHC class I expression" -> "Decreased recognition by cytotoxic T-cells" -> "Reduced killing of tumor cells" -> "Natural killer cells" -> "Most capable of killing tumor cells" -> 95%
analysis: The immune system cell most capable of killing tumor cells with decreased MHC class I expression is the cytotoxic T-cells. Cytotoxic T-cells recognize and kill cells that display abnormal or foreign antigens, such as cancerous cells with reduced MHC class I expression.
